title: Book 9 — Calliope, Chapter 30
paragraphs: Of the light-armed fighting men, then, the total was 69,500. The entire Greek force assembled at Plataea numbered (including both hoplites and light-armed fighters) 110,000 — less by 1,800. With the Thespians present, the full figure of 110,000 was made up; for of the Thespians who survived, about 1,800 were present in the army — also without heavy armor. These, then, having been drawn up in order, were encamped on the river Asopos.
